headline: Votes on $475,776.68 and $200,000.00 in bill payments, plus updates on Central Falls High School and Raices school projects.
summary: Updates cover the high school, the Raices Dual Language School, and other projects, including abatement and demolition, a retaining wall, and track and field replacement. The agenda also asks for votes on bill payments, possible future revolving fund projects, and the 2027 meeting schedule.
items: Minority and women business enterprise update
Revolving fund subcommittee update, including Ella Risk bathroom renovations
Review potential future projects for revolving fund
Payments of outstanding bills, Bond Series 2025 Requisition # 7, $475,776.68
